claim: Deterministic generation makes the same input reproduce the same asset output.
A game-ready asset needs evaluation beyond visual appearance, including export and budget considerations.

A controlled 12-seed capture of one stylized cottage archetype produced 12 distinct preview files with no capture-run console errors; a separate deterministic regression command completed successfully.
methodology: See marketing/research/cottage-seed-study-2026-08-25.md. This is a visual variation study, not a benchmark of mesh quality, runtime cost, or commercial readiness.
